pairs.gold_text: Injuries were confirmed and documented in Nerridge during the collapse response.
pairs.system_text: Injuries were confirmed and documented following the collapse at Aldan House on Cobbett Row in Nerridge.

pairs.gold_text: Nerridge fire service reported rescuing nine people during the initial response to the Aldan House collapse.
pairs.system_text: Nine people were rescued by the Nerridge Fire Service.

pairs.gold_text: The collapse destroyed Aldan House and its east wing.
pairs.system_text: <PERSON> and its east wing were destroyed as a result of a structural collapse on Cobbett Row.

pairs.gold_text: Service at Aldan House was reported disrupted.

pairs.gold_text: Provincial Urban Search and Rescue deployed during the collapse response.
pairs.system_text: Provincial Urban Search and Rescue (PUSAR) was deployed to the collapse site at Aldan House in Nerridge.

pairs.gold_text: Nerridge Emergency Management provided information about the east wing during the response.
pairs.system_text: Nerridge Emergency Management provided official information regarding the collapsed wing at Aldan House.

pairs.gold_text: Requests for assistance were reported from Imber Street during the early phase of the emergency.
pairs.system_text: Assistance was requested on the street and at Imber Street in Nerridge.

pairs.gold_text: A warning was issued for Cobbett Row during the initial response to the collapse.
